dmso-f1.name: DMSO Safety, its label folded in
dmso-f1.text: This protocol has you smell DMSO for anxiety and brain fog. It's a solvent that goes straight through your skin and lungs into your blood, and it can carry in whatever else is in the bottle or on your skin. So you should use 99.9% Pharmaceutical Grade DMSO, ideally in a glass bottle, since it can leach chemicals out of some plastics. It's sold on Amazon and other sites (I've never had a bad batch). Before using it, wash any lotions or other products off your hands and nose. Your lungs need to be clean too, so if you're a smoker, breathe in only a little at a time, since it can pull the tar from your lungs into your blood, and stop if you feel weak right afterwards, which is the first sign of that (there's more on all this in my full DMSO reference).

ethno-f1.name: Ethnobotanicals, its label folded in
ethno-f1.text: The plant medicines in this protocol are iboga (an African root bark) and psilocybin mushrooms. Both are illegal in many jurisdictions and carry risks, and iboga can be dangerous for your heart. So never combine iboga with most medications (especially heart & psych meds). If you take any medication, ask an AI whether it's one of them, since AI is pretty good at that (my full iboga guide here lists some of them, and the iboga microdosing protocol is here). Ask the AI about the mushrooms too, since lithium, for one, has been tied to seizures when taken with psychedelics.

iso-f1.name: Behavioral Warning, its label folded in, "the isolation trap" kept in its third sentence
iso-f1.text: This neural de-armoring protocol demands starving your brain of "Phasic" Dopamine, which works in the brain to produce learning and excitement when chasing novelty. The easiest way for most folks to take a break from that is to hole up alone. But don't fall into the isolation trap of cutting yourself off completely, because that actually spikes cortisol, the chronic stress hormone. And cortisol sensitizes your brain to glutamate, thus locking the old neural armor in place that we're trying to gently remove. Calm company, like nature walk buddies, goes the other way, anchoring you via oxytocin, the bonding hormone. Good friends are ultimately more vital than any brain repair protocol.

rule-f1.text: My rule for now is to seek "Boring Love", meaning parallel play (like reading next to someone) and touch that feels safe to you. So this may not be a good time to jump into a new romance or drama, though there's no need to leave the partner you have.

cog-faces-f1.name: Cognitive Warning (30 words), its label folded in, with the paragraph after it
cog-faces-f1.text:
As you de-armor, you will feel naked and exposed. You will assume everyone can see your anxiety, which they mostly can't. Nicholas Epley, Mindwise, calls this the "Illusion of Transparency."

Your armored brain also reads the threat it feels into neutral faces, so you will think people are judging you when they're mostly just thinking about themselves. So during this protocol, do not trust your social intuition: assume you are misreading every room, at least until your heart rate is back down to your usual resting rate, and under 90 BPM, since a racing heart means your reasoning brain is offline (see the "Metabolic Red Line" below).

agm-f1.text: Agmatine, the "voltage regulator", acts like a brake on NMDA/glutamate signaling, which is why we use it in this protocol. But we'll keep it as an optional add-on, since it can interact with a lot more medications than the protocol's safer nutrients would (magnesium, phosphatidylcholine, etc.). People may think it's pretty safe, since it's a common health supplement, but we have to treat it with caution since it acts powerfully on imidazoline/alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, nitric-oxide pathways, and opioid reward/tolerance.

htp-f1.name: The warning for psychedelic users, its label folded in, "it" named as 5-HTP
htp-f1.text: Uridine and 5-HTP are in this protocol for repairing neural signaling, and they can quickly change how strongly psychedelics hit you, so don't mix everything together all at once. Especially dangerous would be to take 5-HTP with anything else that raises serotonin levels, since 5-HTP is also what your body makes serotonin out of. That's how folks end up with serotonin syndrome, which can be deadly (see the 5-HTP section). The following drugs are especially dangerous to take with 5-HTP: SSRIs, SNRIs, MAOIs (including ayahuasca), linezolid, lithium, tramadol, methadone, fentanyl, DXM, MDMA, St. John's wort, SAM-e or L-tryptophan. Do not use 5-HTP anywhere near iboga, even when microdosing, because ibogaine and noribogaine in iboga interact with serotonin transport.
